title: faction 0.9.0 -- the data model
description: Every command, result, outcome and view, and the forms of a conformance vector and of the decision table. Normative with SPEC.md.

u64.description: A u64 as a string of decimal digits: no sign, no leading zero, no exponent.

positive_u64.description: A u64 of one or more, as a string of decimal digits: no sign, no leading zero, no exponent.

epoch.description: The version of a membership: a u64 of one or more, as a string of decimal digits. Epoch 0 is omitted wherever it would stand.

nothing.description: The payload of a value that carries nothing.

peers.description: Peer ids in arrival order, none twice.

instance.description: A node and an incarnation the caller guarantees never repeats for that node: what tells one instance's receipts from another's.

configuration.description: What a node is created from: its instance -- its node's id and an incarnation -- its genesis peers, the required count, the suspicion threshold and, unless 0, the epoch of its membership, and, if provisional, that its membership is.

provisional.description: A newcomer's membership, offered by its coordinator, before its own addition commits; omitted when not.

reconfiguration.description: The change in flight: none, an addition requested of a peer or acknowledged by it, or a removal of a peer requested.

misses.description: Each member that has missed one or more periods running and is not suspected, with how many, in the members' order.

last_probed.description: The member probed last: none yet, or the member.

quorum.description: Not tracked before the conclusion; then held while the members not suspected number the required count or more, lost while they number fewer.

cluster_view.description: What a node shows of its state.

provisional.description: Whether the node's membership is provisional; omitted when not.

admissible.description: The commands the node's stage admits, by name, in the commands' order.

receipt.description: Every call's answer: its output, and its number, one more than the instance's last receipt's, the first being 1.

final.description: The receipt a Probe after the last step must be given: numbered one more than the last step's, the view and the admissible commands.

vector.description: A conformance vector: a configuration, steps, and the final answer a closing Probe must be given.

matrix.description: The decision table: what each stage admits, then the rows in the order they are checked.

admits.description: What each stage admits, by name, in the commands' order.

released.description: Every vector of every released version, by its file's name, the version that released its bytes and the SHA-256 digest of them, the version that withdrew it, if one did, and the version that re-encoded it, if one did, with its re-encoded bytes' digest; and every command a released version names, by its name and the first released version to name it.

reencoded.description: The version that re-encoded the vector, changing no answer, and the SHA-256 digest of its re-encoded bytes; its released bytes are kept under released/, by the last version that wrote them.
